new_candidates.body:
Thank you for sharing your work on [RLBench](https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.12271)!

I am Lingdong from the [WorldBench](https://github.com/worldbench) team and a co-author of [Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24744).

**We plan to discuss your work in the next revision of our survey.**

Your work is already included in our accompanying [reading list](https://github.com/worldbench/awesome-embodied-data-pyramid#table-simulation-benchmarks) under **Simulation benchmarks**. We would welcome any corrections or updated resources, such as paper versions, project pages, datasets, code, or release information, as well as suggestions for accurate coverage of your work in the survey. Please feel free to open a pull request to update the existing entry, or reply here with suggestions.

Thank you for sharing your work with the community!

Lingdong\
From the [WorldBench](https://github.com/worldbench) team
new_candidates.title: Invitation to review the RLBench entry in the Embodied Data Pyramid reading list
